Haha, it truly shows how special this  company is that people would want to randomly stop by a stranger's workplace. I love everything about this.

You're not wrong. OTH, other workplaces I've visited for which I didn't know anyone working there are below. Most of these are tours, but then if GtG offered tours of their warehouse, I bet people would take them.

 

  • Radiology center at IUPUI. We got a tour of the imaging machines and 3D printing. This was 10+ years ago when 3D printing was much more rare.
  • Tortilla factory in Cabo San Lucas. Part of a food tour.
  • Many vineyards and a few breweries
  • Candy factory in Talinn. Part of a tour.
  • Coffee plantation tour.
  • Bacardi Distillery tour.
 

Ugh. Remembering and listing all the tours is getting tedious, but I expect you get the point.
